_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — not shipped in the Magic NPCs jar. Copy this into your own datapack at data/<your_namespace>/spellcasters/skeleton.json (or config/openloader/data/<pack>/data/<pack>/spellcasters/skeleton.json for OpenLoader) to make vanilla skeletons cast. The file name does not matter; the 'entity_type' field is the opt-in. Add "replace": true to override any other datapack's skeleton loadout instead of pooling with it.
